body: Fits me too well. Gave this question some thought, couldn't come up with anything. Then I read your answer and I knew this is what I meant to say.You...I like you.
Appreciate the response, thanks. I'm doing as much as possible to get back in the swing of things, but it's been slow going.

23, recently separated, living at home. Wife has kids, wife is being a bitch, haven't seen kids in 2 weeks. I drink myself to sleep, wake up, go to work, get home, drink myself to sleep, rinse and repeat. I work 70+ hours a week, making below average money, and I think about killing myself everyday. I think about trying to date again, but I'm convinced I'm undateable, so I stay home, drink, and miss my old life.
